title: 010尽在掌控
slug: 年少情深被辜负他跪了我不要了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

送走潘廷旭，敲定局面的这一刻，李铭烨心底笃定，这一局他稳赢！

接下来几日，他故意腾出所有工作时间，推掉应酬，在家耐心陪着备考的林萧。

甚至像从前在出租屋那样，亲手给林萧做她喜欢吃的家常菜。

虽然手艺不太好，但林萧还是给了面子，吃了几口。

而且，李铭烨还主动解除手机免打扰，取消锁屏密码，将手机随意搁在林萧常经过的玄关拐角。

刻意的缓和与迁就，确实消解了两人连日以来的僵硬对峙，家里的低气压渐渐散去，相处氛围松弛了不少。

李铭烨早早起身，细心替林萧挑选了清爽得体的通勤穿搭，一如从前那般温柔，抬手为她轻轻束了一个利落的低丸子头，

十点，车子准时停在星野传媒公司的楼下。

林萧下车前，李铭烨突然俯过身子，宽大的手掌轻松扣住了她的手腕。

没等林萧反应过来，李铭烨便在她的手背如蜻蜓点水般落下一吻。

“加油！我的萧萧这么厉害，肯定能成功！”

林萧下意识抬手抽回手腕，脸颊微热，没留意他温柔笑意底下，藏着一丝敛得极好的阴鸷与算计。

“知道了。”她避开李铭烨的目光，“考完我自己回去，不用你来接。”

这话瞬间让李铭烨眼底的温柔淡去几分，他刻意蹙起眉，“我就要接。”

林萧无奈白了他一眼，生怕耽误复试时间，索性不再争辩，转身快步走进星野的办公大楼。

目送她的身影彻底消失在视线里，李铭烨脸上的温柔笑意缓缓褪去，周身气息瞬间冷沉下来。

这几日的刻意示弱，温柔迁就并非徒劳。

林萧对他的戒备明显松动，两人的关系肉眼可见的回温。

可越是这样，李铭烨心底的忌惮越深。

他太清楚，这份平和只是暂时的。

潘廷旭的存在，林萧想要独立的执念，始终是扎在他心头的刺。

为了彻底稳住局面，杜绝后患，他需要提前布局，堵死所有隐患。

沉吟片刻，他发动车子，调转方向，去往周冉冉的住处。

他从不是闲来无事消遣，更不是所谓的犒劳自己，而是刻意赴一场试探与拿捏。

周冉冉开门时，脸上立刻扬起清甜的笑意，身形微侧，双手背在身后，歪头看着眼前的男人，语气软糯：

“哥哥，你怎么突然过来了？是不生我的气了吗？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

At the moment when Pan Tingxu was sent away and the situation was finalized, Li Mingye was convinced that he would win this round!

In the next few days, he deliberately spared all his working time, put down social activities, and patiently stayed with Lin Xiao at home, who was preparing for the exam.

She even cooked Lin Xiao's favorite home-cooked dishes with her own hands, just like she did in the rental house before.

Although his craftsmanship was not very good, Lin Xiao still gave him face and took a few bites.

Moreover, Li Mingye took the initiative to disable Do Not Disturb on his phone, canceled the lock screen password, and casually placed his phone at the corner of the entrance where Lin Xiao often passed by.

Deliberate relaxation and accommodation have indeed resolved the stiff confrontation between the two people for days. The low pressure at home gradually dissipated, and the atmosphere of getting along became much more relaxed.

Li Mingye got up early and carefully chose fresh and decent commuting clothes for Lin Xiao. He was as gentle as before. He raised his hand and gently tied her hair into a neat low bun.

At ten o'clock, the car stopped downstairs at Hoshino Media Company on time.

Before Lin Xiao got out of the car, Li Mingye suddenly leaned over and easily grasped her wrist with his broad palm.

Before Lin Xiao could react, Li Mingye placed a kiss on the back of her hand like a dragonfly touching water.

"Come on! My Xiao Xiao is so powerful, I will definitely succeed!"

Lin Xiao subconsciously raised his hand to withdraw his wrist, his cheeks were slightly warm, and he didn't notice that there was a hint of evil and calculation hidden under his gentle smile.

"I know." She avoided Li Mingye's gaze, "I will go back by myself after the exam, you don't need to pick me up."

These words instantly made the tenderness in Li Mingye's eyes fade a bit, and he frowned deliberately, "I'm going to take it."

Lin Xiao rolled his eyes at him helplessly. For fear of delaying the re-examination time, he simply stopped arguing and turned around and quickly walked into Hoshino's office building.

Watching her figure completely disappear from sight, the gentle smile on Li Mingye's face slowly faded, and the aura around him suddenly became cold.

The deliberate show of weakness and gentleness and accommodation in the past few days are not in vain.

Lin Xiao's guard against him was obviously loosened, and the relationship between the two was visibly warming up.

But the more this happened, the deeper the fear in Li Mingye's heart became.

He knew too well that this peace was only temporary.

Pan Tingxu's existence and Lin Xiao's obsession with independence have always been a thorn in his heart.

In order to completely stabilize the situation and prevent future troubles, he needs to make arrangements in advance to block all hidden dangers.

After pondering for a moment, he started the car, changed direction, and went to Zhou Ranran's residence.

He never had nothing to do to entertain himself, let alone the so-called reward for himself, but deliberately went for a test and trial.

When Zhou Ranran opened the door, a sweet smile immediately appeared on her face. She tilted her body slightly, put her hands behind her back, tilted her head and looked at the man in front of her, and said in a soft tone:

"Brother, why did you come here suddenly? Are you not angry with me?"
